title: Northern Rivers medium size business grant – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for the Northern Rivers medium size business grant.
who_can_apply: $50,000 February and March 2022 storm and flood disaster recovery small business grant
$75,000 Primary Producer Special Disaster grant for the February 2022 NSW floods
what_you_need: Owned assets must be evidenced by a title search, rates notice and/or Certificate of Title.
Assets used predominantly for business activities must be evidenced by financial records, photos, video evidence, tax return or a statutory declaration.
Replacement of lost or damaged stock must be essential for immediately resuming business operation.
Repair or replacement of motor vehicles must be directly damaged from the 2022 Floods, registered for business use, and essential for business reinstatement.
Leasing temporary premises must be for the purpose of resuming business operation.
Temporary adoption of an online business model is an eligible cost.
